text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As summer training camp got underway, 
Transcend set out to develop a "certain 
gadget." She says it's meant for winning 
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The co-developers are Air Shakur, who 
excels at programming, and Agnes Tachyon, 
who is always conducting suspicious 
experiments.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just what kind of thing would it turn out 
to be? "Look forward to it," Transcend 
chuckled to herself.
